findings.detail: The 2025 filing contains a separate prior-period SOI with total fair value 1,029,942,922; the B01 denominator includes those comparative rows, producing 114 current-year fair-value rows out of 231 extracted leaves.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate review. The raw SOI has a current-year investment schedule with a 2025 total fair value of 1,250,833,285 (table 28 row 20) and a distinct comparative schedule with a prior-period total fair value of 1,029,942,922 (table 33 row 24). Representative current investment rows also show source fair-value cells, so the 114/231 B01 completeness failure is not because the source omits fair values; it is caused by comparative-period rows being included in the 2025 extracted leaf population.
